subject: Small code error in Stan 2.3 Manual

messages.author: cd1404481f4e2345
messages.subject: Small code error in Stan 2.3 Manual
parts:
Dear wonderful Stan developer types,

In the section on "Multivariate Priors for Hierarchical Models," at the beginning of "Optimizations" (p. 38 in the text). I'm pretty sure that:

 Sigma_beta
       <- diag_pre_multiply(tau, diag_post_multiply(Sigma, tau));


Should read:

 Sigma_beta
       <- diag_pre_multiply(tau, diag_post_multiply(Omega, tau));



Thanks,
Avi

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Small code error in Stan 2.3 Manual
parts:
Thanks for catching the error.

As of version 2.3, the best way to do this is:

Sigma_beta <- quad_form_diag(Sigma,tau);

where

quad_form_diag(Sigma,tau)

=def= diag_matrix(tau)' * Sigma * diag_matrix(tau)

I'll change the example for the next release. Here's
the issue tracker reference:

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/668#issuecomment-48208721

- Bob

That's great. And thanks for highlighting the quad_form_diag() command---I'm using it in my code now.

Also, be sure that the version that goes into the manual is: "Sigma_beta <- quad_form_diag(Omega, tau);" (rather than the version you've written below). Just want to be consistent on Sigmas, Omegas, etc.

Thanks,
Avi
